prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production UI background asset for ASIST, wide 16:9, 2048x1152. Almost-black midnight navy vast sky, very sparse tiny blue stars. Dark rugged mountain ridges only across the bottom quarter, left ridge descending toward central valley, right ridge rising at edge, cold subtle blue rimlight. Central and upper 75 percent are extremely dark quiet negative space for legible UI. Refined photoreal cinematic landscape, deep blacks, subdued cobalt/violet horizon. No aurora, no planet, no moon, no orb, no typography, no UI, no borders. Match the very dark blue mountain landscape of a futuristic cyan-violet glass assistant desktop.

Designed to layer over animated canvas rings.
